top_categories.workout_context: Race-pace efforts that mimic GFNY Paracas' demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before June.
GFNY Paracas' mixed terrain rewards steady threshold power. Surging and recovering costs more watts than just holding.

Road-specific control matters at GFNY Paracas. Practice on mixed terrain: use smooth gear and cadence changes, accelerate deliberately out of corners, and settle quickly back into sustainable power for 72 miles.
When someone attacks on mixed terrain, you have 10 seconds to respond or you're off the back. This builds that response.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of GFNY Paracas. Train it until it feels boring.
72 miles on mixed terrain burns energy faster than the distance suggests. Train the fade resistance now.
At GFNY Paracas, changes in grade or pace can lift effort above threshold before it settles again. Over-unders train that transition while you keep riding.
2-minute all-out efforts on mixed terrain. Closing gaps, responding to attacks, sprinting for position. Train the burn.
Brief efforts above sustainable power can come from grade changes, positioning, or closing a gap at GFNY Paracas. Train them without letting those efforts derail the longer pacing plan.
Double-threshold training builds sustained power with less fatigue. More FTP per hour of training.
Long rides with hard efforts mixed in. Simulates what GFNY Paracas' mixed terrain actually does to you.
Varied gradients on mixed terrain demand climbing versatility. Sit the shallow stuff, stand the steep stuff, switch without thinking.

race_overlay.weather: June in Paracas, Ica, Peru — Coastal Peruvian desert in June (Southern Hemisphere winter): mild temperatures, minimal rain, but persistent, powerful Pacific onshore wind. Rehearse adaptable layers and race-day kit changes in the final 2 weeks, including rain protection and wet-road braking, and practice stable positioning in crosswinds before GFNY Paracas. Use the organizer's current forecast and safety instructions for final choices.
race_overlay.nutrition: Use training to rehearse an eating and drinking plan for GFNY Paracas' 72 miles. Start early and use products you tolerate. The organizer has not published a reliable resupply plan, so rehearse a self-sufficient carry and revise it when the rider document is released.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on Race Simulation, TT Threshold, and Road Specific to prepare you for 72 miles of mixed terrain in Paracas, Ica, Peru.
